description: Scan four GELU blends around the one-example QKV-union boundary
proposal: Family: feed-forward width. Current retained frontier is 1,671 parameters at 99.000000%, exactly threshold (+0.000000 margin). There have been 21 prior macro-attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0139/micro-0001 at 1,671/99.00%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0141/micro-0001, where QKV pair 555/517 scored 98.99% at 1,670 under alpha=0.5; the same pair scored 98.99% under exact GELU in attempt-0091. Hypothesis: a modest off-center activation blend can compensate the single changed QKV scalar while preserving the learned function. The helper tests fixed alphas 0.25, 0.75, 0.125, 0.875, one official micro-trial each. Stop on first acceptance because all candidates share 1,670 parameters, after four trials, on error, or after eight wall-clock minutes. This is more informative than a dense activation grid because the symmetric widening order samples the largest distinct offsets around measured alpha=0/0.5 failures within a strict cap.
summary: Tested QKV union 555/517 with GELU-blend alphas 0.25, 0.75, 0.125, and 0.875. Every 1,670-parameter candidate scored exactly 98.99%, so all were discarded and rolled back; frontier stayed 1,671/99.00%. Outcomes: 0 accepts, 4 scored nonqualifications, 0 errors. Compute used four migrations and official verifications over about 5m10s. Stop reason: reached the declared four-point/eight-minute boundary, demonstrating this failed example is insensitive to the tested activation blend.
